_note: Sentences for a word calendar (src/lib/merchKalender.ts in the older course; no live page reads this file at the moment): Spanish proverbs (refranes) and idioms used in Spain, each with `sub`, the meaning in simple English (A2–B1). Well-known expressions, no quotations (those are in src/data/zitate.json). The idioms come from src/data/redewendungen.json. Draft 2026-11-06, not yet proofread.

sprichwoerter.text: A quien madruga, Dios le ayuda.
sprichwoerter.sub: = If you get up early, things go better.

sprichwoerter.text: Más vale tarde que nunca.
sprichwoerter.sub: = It is better to do something late than not at all.

sprichwoerter.text: No hay mal que por bien no venga.
sprichwoerter.sub: = Something good can come out of a bad thing.

sprichwoerter.text: Más vale pájaro en mano que ciento volando.
sprichwoerter.sub: = What you have is worth more than what you only might get.

sprichwoerter.text: A caballo regalado no se le mira el diente.
sprichwoerter.sub: = Do not criticise a gift.

sprichwoerter.text: En boca cerrada no entran moscas.
sprichwoerter.sub: = Sometimes it is better to say nothing.

sprichwoerter.text: Dime con quién andas y te diré quién eres.
sprichwoerter.sub: = Your friends say a lot about you.

sprichwoerter.text: Ojos que no ven, corazón que no siente.
sprichwoerter.sub: = What you do not know cannot hurt you.

sprichwoerter.text: Quien mucho abarca, poco aprieta.
sprichwoerter.sub: = If you try to do too much, you do nothing well.

sprichwoerter.text: Al mal tiempo, buena cara.
sprichwoerter.sub: = Stay positive when things go badly.

sprichwoerter.text: Perro ladrador, poco mordedor.
sprichwoerter.sub: = People who threaten a lot rarely do anything.

sprichwoerter.text: El que algo quiere, algo le cuesta.
sprichwoerter.sub: = You have to work or pay for what you want.

sprichwoerter.text: Camarón que se duerme, se lo lleva la corriente.
sprichwoerter.sub: = If you do not pay attention, you lose your chance.

sprichwoerter.text: Hablando se entiende la gente.
sprichwoerter.sub: = People solve problems by talking.

sprichwoerter.text: No por mucho madrugar amanece más temprano.
sprichwoerter.sub: = You cannot make things happen sooner by hurrying.

sprichwoerter.text: Cada loco con su tema.
sprichwoerter.sub: = Everyone has their own obsession.

sprichwoerter.text: Agua que no has de beber, déjala correr.
sprichwoerter.sub: = Leave alone what does not concern you.

sprichwoerter.text: A lo hecho, pecho.
sprichwoerter.sub: = Accept what you have done and face it.

sprichwoerter.text: Zapatero, a tus zapatos.
sprichwoerter.sub: = Stick to what you know.

sprichwoerter.text: Quien tiene un amigo tiene un tesoro.
sprichwoerter.sub: = A friend is worth a treasure.

sprichwoerter.text: Donde fueres, haz lo que vieres.
sprichwoerter.sub: = Do as the local people do.

sprichwoerter.text: De tal palo, tal astilla.
sprichwoerter.sub: = Children are like their parents.

sprichwoerter.text: Más vale prevenir que curar.
sprichwoerter.sub: = It is better to stop a problem than to fix it later.

sprichwoerter.text: Año de nieves, año de bienes.
sprichwoerter.sub: = A year with a lot of snow brings good harvests.

sprichwoerter.text: En abril, aguas mil.
sprichwoerter.sub: = It rains a lot in April.

sprichwoerter.text: Hasta el cuarenta de mayo, no te quites el sayo.
sprichwoerter.sub: = Keep your warm clothes until well into spring.

sprichwoerter.text: Las apariencias engañan.
sprichwoerter.sub: = Things are not always what they seem.

sprichwoerter.text: Aunque la mona se vista de seda, mona se queda.
sprichwoerter.sub: = Fine clothes do not change who you are.

sprichwoerter.text: Cría cuervos y te sacarán los ojos.
sprichwoerter.sub: = People you help may turn against you.

sprichwoerter.text: El tiempo es oro.
sprichwoerter.sub: = Time is valuable.

sprichwoerter.text: Querer es poder.
sprichwoerter.sub: = If you really want something, you can do it.

sprichwoerter.text: Poco a poco se va lejos.
sprichwoerter.sub: = Small steps take you a long way.

sprichwoerter.text: Lo barato sale caro.
sprichwoerter.sub: = Cheap things can cost more in the end.

sprichwoerter.text: Quien ríe el último, ríe mejor.
sprichwoerter.sub: = The person who wins in the end is the one who can laugh.

sprichwoerter.text: A buen entendedor, pocas palabras bastan.
sprichwoerter.sub: = A clever person understands without a long explanation.

sprichwoerter.text: Nunca es tarde si la dicha es buena.
sprichwoerter.sub: = A good thing is welcome, even if it comes late.

redewendungen.sub: = To be crazy, in a harmless or funny way.
= To be a coward.
= To make something simple complicated, or to look for problems where there are none.
= To cheat someone by giving them something worse than they paid for.
= Very few people.

redewendungen.text: Llevarse como el perro y el gato
redewendungen.sub: = To get on very badly and argue all the time.

redewendungen.text: No ver tres en un burro
redewendungen.sub: = To see very badly.
= To pay attention, to be well informed about what is happening.
= To be very easy.

redewendungen.text: Al pan, pan y al vino, vino
redewendungen.sub: = To say things clearly and honestly, without softening them.
= Not to matter to someone at all.
= To turn someone down in love; also, to fail someone in an exam.
= To go red in the face, from embarrassment.
= To feel completely comfortable and happy in a situation.

redewendungen.text: La gota que colma el vaso
redewendungen.sub: = The small thing that finally makes a situation impossible to bear.

redewendungen.text: Sacarle las castañas del fuego a alguien
redewendungen.sub: = To solve a difficult problem that someone else caused.
= To tease someone, to make them believe something that isn't true.
= To make a silly mistake, to say or do the wrong thing.
= To help someone.
= To be completely fed up.
= To be shameless, to take advantage of others without any embarrassment.
= To keep getting things wrong, to do nothing right.
= To frighten or shock someone.

redewendungen.text: Costar un ojo de la cara
redewendungen.sub: = To be very expensive.
= To get going, to start making a real effort.
= To have no money at all.

redewendungen.text: Tirar la casa por la ventana
redewendungen.sub: = To spend a lot of money on something, especially a celebration.
= To have enough money to live until the next salary.
= To make a lot of money quickly, thanks to a good chance.
= To take the blame or the consequences for something, usually something others did.
= To save tiny amounts that make no real difference.
= Not to pay attention, to be thinking of something else.
= To rain very hard.
= It is extremely cold.

redewendungen.text: Ahogarse en un vaso de agua
redewendungen.sub: = To get very upset about a small problem.
= For a new problem to come on top of earlier ones.
= To come at exactly the right moment and be very welcome.
= To talk a lot, without stopping.

redewendungen.text: No tener pelos en la lengua
redewendungen.sub: = To say exactly what you think, even if it's uncomfortable.
= To talk about side issues instead of the main point.
